text: Before clearing an aircraft for takeoff, it is the responsibility of the tower controller to maintain appropriate spacing between aircraft. This distance varies depending on the route of flight, the type of aircraft, and weather conditions. At times of low visibility, the controller uses surface radar to monitor the position of each aircraft on the ground. What do controllers use in low visibility conditions?
